parameters.name: DstType
parameters.description:
The type of the destination. Valid values:

- **Domain**: domain name.

- **DstIP**: IP address.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content. Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese.

- **en**: English.

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the visitor.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
